observed: Home loads existing synthetic vault with four quick actions, including add agent and invite teammate.
Team page preserves the existing pending invitation and its administrator role.
Invalid alias with details collapsed reopens and focuses the field.
Actual single x key changes invalid alias to invalid aliasx; validation error clears while details stays open and input retains focus (UX-05 native PASS).
Repeated invalid submission with details already open refocuses the alias input.
Used invite is rejected again in the final build; link input is cleared and its inline error is displayed.
With the join error present, opening local-name details leaves visible focus on the summary instead of replaying link focus.

Clicking the local field, then a separate real x key event changes codex-final/dev to codex-final/devx. Details stays open, caret stays in local field, and the link error remains visible (N8/N10 native coverage).
Home Add agent shortcut navigates to Agents and opens its connection sheet; optional setup remains available after shorter onboarding.

Keys and Connections show their empty-state actions; Records renders actual synthetic audit entries; Incidents shows its empty state; Settings renders the persisted gateway and team-listener configuration. No mutation was performed in those smoke checks.
NoVNC task clipboard was cleared, the browser viewport was reset, and the temporary browser tab was closed after native checks.
Additional bounded sharing check: Home Invite teammate opens the combined sheet. Created a deliberately separate Clipboard E2E invite with user role on the already shared environment.

Clicked native Copy, then opened Join and sent native Ctrl+V without writing to the noVNC clipboard between those actions. The pasted value produced the expected own-device fingerprint zr2y4isbejlwc5bciih2jbhq5y, user role and 192.168.5.15:47430 address. This verifies actual native clipboard delivery, not only the success toast. No Join was submitted.
The additional Clipboard E2E invite was explicitly revoked in the UI; its row changed to canceled, while the original Codex E2E teammate invite remained pending.

More than 60 seconds after the successful native copy/paste, the same native Ctrl+V into a fresh focused Join input left it empty. No clipboard write occurred between the positive paste and this check, consistent with the announced timed clearing. Exact 60-second boundary timing was not measured.
After the additional check, the noVNC clipboard was explicitly cleared, viewport restored and temporary browser tab closed again.
limitations: Tab/Space forwarding through the noVNC toolbar was not reliable; no keyboard-only traversal PASS is claimed. Actual single-character edits after confirmed native field focus were observed.
The expiry-specific N10 case is covered by component tests; native error retention used a consumed-invite server rejection.
